exam: SSC CGL Tier 2 2026, Paper I (Staff Selection Commission — Combined Graduate Level)
source_note: Compiled from the SSC's official CGL Tier 2 exam pattern/notification as reported by multiple 2025-2026 coaching/exam-tracker sources (PhysicsWallah, Adda247, CareerPower, ExamSuchana, Prepgrind, Prepp), cross-checked Sep 2026. Tier 2 2026 dropped the earlier Paper III (General Studies: Finance & Economics for AAO posts) per some trackers while others still list it as post-specific — treat Paper III's status as unconfirmed for the live cycle and verify against ssc.gov.in. This file covers Paper I only (compulsory for every post); Paper II (Statistics, for JSO/Statistical Investigator Grade-II posts) is a separate, post-specific paper and is out of scope here.
exam_pattern_note: SSC CGL Tier 2 Paper I 2026: 150 objective MCQs, 450 marks, computer-based online test, split across 5 sections mapped to 3 graded 'Sections' (I, II, III) plus a qualifying Data Entry Speed Test in a separate Session 2. Section I = Mathematical Abilities (30Q) + Reasoning & General Intelligence (30Q); Section II = English Language & Comprehension (45Q) + General Awareness (25Q); Section III = Computer Knowledge (20Q, qualifying-cutoff module — failing its cutoff can disqualify the whole paper regardless of other scores). Session 1 (Sections I-III) runs 2 hours 15 minutes total; Session 2 is the 15-minute Data Entry Speed Test (DEST, 2000 key depressions), itself qualifying only, with no negative marking. Tier 2 Paper I is the MERIT-DECIDING stage — unlike Tier 1, these marks are carried forward into final selection. Reported subject-wise sub-timers within Sections I/II vary across trackers (some describe a single 60-minute block per Section, others describe additional per-subject sub-timers inside that block); verify the live-cycle interface behaviour against the admit card/mock test rather than relying on any single tracker.

Emotional intelligence, social intelligence, situational decision-making
